# Ink Blog

> Minimalist bilingual blog template built with Astro 6, React 19, and Tailwind CSS 4.

Ink Blog is an open-source static blog starter with English/Chinese i18n, dark mode, Pagefind full-text search, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, Giscus comments, RSS feeds, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap, and SEO-ready meta tags. Deploy to Vercel, Netlify, or any static host with zero backend.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/OldJii/ink-blog/blob/main/README.md): Quick start, configuration, content authoring
- [site.config.ts](https://github.com/OldJii/ink-blog/blob/main/site.config.ts): Site title, URL, theme, Giscus, social links

## Features

- Bilingual (en/zh) with automatic language detection
- Dark mode with user preference persistence
- Pagefind static search, Mermaid, KaTeX, Giscus, RSS per language
- JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt, Open Graph, Twitter cards
- Reading time, table of contents, image lightbox

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OldJii/ink-blog.git my-blog
cd my-blog && npm install && npm run dev
```

Edit `site.config.ts` then add Markdown to `src/content/post/en/` and `src/content/post/zh/`.

## Common questions

- **Stack**: Astro 6, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript
- **Deploy**: Vercel recommended; outputs static `dist/`
- **Comments**: Optional Giscus via `site.config.ts`
- **License**: MIT
